questions.prompt: When is a struct allowed to derive the `Copy` trait?

options.a: When the total size of the struct is under 64 bytes
options.b: When every field in the struct is itself `Copy` and the struct owns no heap resources
options.c: When the struct also derives `Debug` and `Default`

questions.prompt: Why does Rust make `Copy` implicit for primitive types while requiring explicit `.clone()` calls for `String`?

options.a: Primitive types are faster to compile
options.b: Bitwise `Copy` is invisible at call sites and only allowed where duplication is trivially cheap; heap allocation is expensive and must remain visible during code review via `.clone()`

questions.prompt: Can a struct containing a `String` field derive `Copy`? (yes/no)
